WORDS: Hello
Welcome back! Today I’m going to show you my Top 3 best projects. Let’s start!
Number 3 is…
Land: SPEED MOD!
This project was a remix of a project named Land.
This project made Land Platformer fast! It also added a high score.
Number 2 is…
Half dash!
Credit to my sadly no long best friend hiya girl. She named the project half dash
because half for 1 half year on scratch, and dash because it’s mario-like.
I’m still thinking about more updates to the game. But I will need my followers help!
Speaking of help, I’m making my 1 year celebration! Click the link in the comments below for more info.
Finally, number 1 is…
hello
Clicker game against AI! (Tournament Mode).
This toke days and hours and weeks. But when I finished, I loved it.
This is my most loved and my most faved project!
Yay!
That is the end of this animation! I hope you enjoyed. Bye!
Also, enjoy my new outro that changes every holiday.
